m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>Once again, and to an even greater extent than before, the dunes stretch out endlessly, baking beneath the desert sun. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>To the west, you can make out a swirling cloud of sand, pouring through a mass of suspended rock to the desert floor, the Chronoverge. </ITALICS>
Oh, look Master! There it is. The Binny Jezzerit Sister said the portal would be flashy, and it sure is. That's how we get to the Chronoverge.
<ITALICS>You step out of the portal to find yourself on a ledge protruding from the suspended stone you saw from the Wastes. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Overhead, the Sands of Time slowly swirl downward to be funneled through the Chronoverge and on to the desert floor.  </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Inside, you should be able to find the Chronomaster and deliver the request from House Tabbi. </ITALICS>
Welcome. It's not often we get visitors here... wait, you must be the Wizard Tyrehl mentioned - the one who dueled Xerxes in his own tomb.
Now that the Agouti Chronoshard is secured, we need a Chronomancer to come and perform the analysis to determine whose claim is stronger.
The Djinni Istar has volunteered herself and the Wizard to visit the Chronoverge and make the official request to the Chronomaster.
I should make the journey as well. The Wizard has already given so much time and talent to this matter. It's only proper we contribute too.
No. Pol Atraydies, the Reverend Mother requests your presence. You must visit the Monastery to officially conclude your trials.
Oh... all right. I must visit the Monastery to officially conclude my trials... Wizard, Istar, I wish you godspeed.
Yes. Be quick. The Chronoverge lies north of Caravan in the Rubal Wastes. The sands have settled and the way is clear. Go.
Our petition to the Chronomaster is as much in your interest as in ours. Tell him we need him here as soon as possible.
